summary: Completed comprehensive frontend E2E and component testing of the AURA Enterprise Platform MVP using Playwright automation. Verified navigation across all 12 modules, real-time pub/sub chat messaging, news feed announcements with comments, Kanban task creation and status updates, and interactive AI assistant responses.
critical_code_review_comments: Clean modular architecture with robust data-testid coverage across all interactive elements.
Fluid 3D canvas hero performs smoothly with 2D fallback and reactive particle simulation.
State transitions across Chat, Feed, Knowledge Wiki, Tasks, and AI Assistant are fully synchronized.
seed_data_creation: Mock initial state provides comprehensive channels, posts, knowledge pages, tasks, and audit logs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core UI flows and module navigations are verified and fully functional.
